brief: Evidence for the user decision: raise the 35B CUDA recipe prefill_chunk from 2048 to 8192 now that fp8-lt is default (#125)? CPU references (-g4k, longer/other splits), gates at 8192 (KL goldens, reuse, acc-short, acc-4k, batch_cuda_real + long), prefill vs vLLM at 1k/4k/16k x3 interleaved, 4-stream aggregate decode and ITL at both chunks. Default not changed.
hypothesis: Chunk 8192 keeps every accuracy gate (thresholds unchanged) and gives +6-11% prefill at 4k/16k; the price is a longer decode stall when a prompt prefills beside decoding streams, because the busy chunk follows the solo chunk.
